- User asked for an analysis (not yet implementation) of whether the Memory Compactor agent run, which currently appears on the frontend (run history/workspace tree), should be hidden from the frontend via a backend environment-variable/setting, using the existing backend "settings service" infra.
- Working repo: `/Users/normy/autobyteus_org/autobyteus-workspace-superrepo` (git branch `personal`, worktree is behind `origin/personal` by 32 commits with local uncommitted `package.json` changes and various untracked `dist`/`.article-work` directories — unrelated to this task).

This is a highly relevant constraint for the new request to hide it, since it may conflict with that earlier explicit preference (see Unverified/open conflicts below).

## Requests and instructions received
- User (latest, open): "currently there are a few agents for example, the memory compactor agent. when memory compactor agent is triggered, it is also shown on the frontend. but i think this agent is internal. so i think could use environment variable like setting to control whether it should appear on frontend or not. in backend we already have setting service. if its possible that would be the best, please analyse" — open; only investigation/analysis has been performed so far, no proposal has yet been presented back to the user, no implementation has started.

## Decisions and findings
- `BUILT_IN_AGENT_DEFINITIONS` (in `autobyteus-server-ts/src/built-in-agents/built-in-agent-registry.ts`) defines two built-in agents: Memory Compactor (`MEMORY_COMPACTOR_AGENT_DEFINITION_ID = "autobyteus-memory-compactor"`, no `settingDefault`) and Retrospective Skill Improver (`RETROSPECTIVE_SKILL_IMPROVER_AGENT_DEFINITION_ID`, with a `settingDefault.key = AUTOBYTEUS_RETROSPECTIVE_SKILL_IMPROVER_AGENT_DEFINITION_ID`). This shows there's already a per-built-in-agent setting mechanism, but only Skill Improver uses it (for selecting which definition id to use), not for visibility.
- `ServerSettingsService` (`autobyteus-server-ts/src/services/server-settings-service.ts`) registers predefined settings via `registerPredefinedSetting(key, description, ...)`, e.g. `APPLICATIONS_CAPABILITY_SETTING_KEY` ("Controls whether the Applications module is available for this node at runtime") and `SKILL_IMPROVEMENT_CAPABILITY_SETTING_KEY = "ENABLE_SKILL_IMPROVEMENT"` ("Controls whether manual Skill Improvement is available... Defaults to disabled."). These two settings demonstrate an existing pattern for boolean capability-style settings read from `appConfigProvider.config.get(KEY)`.
- `AppConfig.get(key, defaultValue)` (`autobyteus-server-ts/src/config/app-config.ts`) reads `process.env[key] ?? this.configData[key] ?? defaultValue` — i.e. settings are effectively environment-variable backed, confirming env-var-based settings are the existing idiom the user wants to reuse.
- Memory Compactor agent run creation flow: `ServerCompactionAgentRunner` (`autobyteus-server-ts/src/agent-execution/compaction/server-compaction-agent-runner.ts`) calls through `AgentRunService.createAgentRun` → `AgentRunProvisioningService` → `AgentRunHistoryCatalogService.recordPreparedRun`, i.e., it is recorded in the normal run history/catalog pipeline — the same pipeline used by ordinary visible agent runs. There is no separate/hidden execution path for it.
- Frontend visibility: `WorkspaceAgentRunsTreePanel.vue` calls `runHistoryStore.fetchTree()` / `refreshTreeQuietly()` on a timer, which pulls from GraphQL `listWorkspaceRunHistory`/`workspaceRunHistory` resolvers (`run-history.ts`), backed by `WorkspaceRunHistoryService.getWorkspaceRunHistory` → `AgentRunHistoryService.listRunHistory` + `TeamRunHistoryService.listTeamRunHistory`, which group by `agentDefinitionId`/`agentName` read from the run history index rows. These rows are populated by `AgentRunHistoryCatalogService.recordPreparedRun` with no current filtering by agent id/visibility flag — i.e., any created run including the compactor's is included in the history/tree data returned to frontend.
- Agent Definition catalog separately exposes `agentDefinitions` query via `AgentDefinitionResolver` → `getStudioAgentDefinitionService().getAllAgentDefinitions()`/`getVisibleAgentDefinitions()` (backed by `FileAgentDefinitionProvider.getAllVisible()`), used for definition listing (name/avatar lookups), distinct from run-history listing.
- Key prior design record found: `tickets/done/agent-based-compaction/design-impact-resolution-visible-compactor-runs.md` — states the user explicitly decided compactor runs should use the **normal visible run framework** (not hidden/internal), accepting that it would appear in run history/frontend; this was a deliberate choice to keep compaction inspectable/debuggable and avoid hidden-history/ephemeral special-casing in the backends. This is the most important finding bearing directly on the current request to now hide it.
- No code was found implementing any "hide agent run from frontend" capability/setting; no existing `isInternal`/`hidden` flag on `AgentDefinition`, `BuiltInAgentDefinition`, or run-history rows.

Needs clarification: does the user want to override/reverse that earlier decision specifically for frontend display (while keeping it in the normal AgentRunService framework, data store, etc.), or is a different scope intended (e.g., hide only from the workspace tree UI, but still store/query it in run history for debugging)?
- Unverified: whether adding visibility filtering at the `AgentRunHistoryCatalogService`/`listRunHistory` query layer (gated by a new `ServerSettingsService` boolean, e.g. an env var like `AUTOBYTEUS_HIDE_INTERNAL_AGENT_RUNS` or a `BuiltInAgentDefinition.hiddenFromFrontend` flag) is feasible without touching backend-specific runtime internals (Codex/Claude) — based on investigation, filtering at the run-history/listRunHistory layer looks architecturally clean and would not require backend-internal changes, but this has not been validated against all consumers of run-history/tree data (e.g., sidebar counts, other GraphQL queries) nor tested.
- Unverified: whether other call sites that also use the agent run history (e.g., GraphQL `getAgentRunResumeConfig`, sidebar workspace/team counts) would need equivalent filtering to maintain consistency once compactor runs are excluded from the visible tree — not yet traced exhaustively.
- No analysis or recommendation has yet been presented to the user; the investigation is still in the exploration/evidence-gathering phase.
